questions.explanation: The request line states a method such as GET and a path, and headers carry metadata such as host name and accepted content types. Many requests have no body at all. The client initiates the exchange over an underlying transport connection; link-layer addresses are added much lower in the stack and do not encode the resource being requested. The concrete addresses in the case do not change the rule.
